abUTA

A text-based social media platform built in Java with support for threaded posts, direct messaging, muting, and account blocking.

Overview

This project was designed to simulate a social media platform using object-oriented programming principles. It helped me practice modeling users, posts, interactions, and account controls in a larger Java program.

Technologies Used

  • Java
  • Object-Oriented Programming
  • Git/GitHub

Features

  • Threaded posts
  • Private messaging
  • Muting users
  • Blocking accounts
